Statistical Report of the SIA Mission 2024

Author
Affiliations

George A. Romero, MS

UNMSM | ADIECS | PAMS

Abstract

This report provides a comprehensive statistical summary of the patient data collected during the SIA Mission 2024. The analysis includes descriptive statistics, highlighting key demographic trends, health outcomes, and the prevalence of conditions observed among the participants. By presenting these findings, the report aims to offer valuable insights into the population served and to support future healthcare planning and interventions in similar missions.

Keywords

Descriptive statistics, SIA, PAMS

The following is the general description of the population served in the SIA Mission in 2024. In total, 910 patients were attended, of which 480 were women, 430 were men; additionally, 209 were under 10 years old, 251 were between 19 and 45 years old, and 84 were over 65 years old. The population served came from a total of 32 communities and 572 patients had SIS. Finally, 433 were first-time patients in the mission, while 459 were returning patients.

The following section presents the results of the descriptive analysis in the form of questions for better understanding and interpretation.
